scope: Bound repeated resolver I/O during each synchronous plugin metadata read
implementation: One context-owned scope reuses package manifests, ancestor package scope and router directory facts across locale/icon/export resolution. Existence, realpath, resource bytes and metadata results remain fresh.
Every call starts and resets its own scope, including caught metadata diagnostics. No inventory or cross-call metadata result cache is introduced.

native.scope: Resources/runtime resolution, metadata, live inventory, bundles, Market listing and manager detail consumers; multilingual manifest I/O bounded to one read and exports/locale edits plus error recovery observed next call

paired.scope: Original exported locale/manifest/icon values and icon byte hashes; diagnostic presence compared, exact prose remains separately recorded

source.failure: Two original file-symlink fixtures fail EPERM on this host; no production assertion failure and these are not counted as passed.

browser.scope: All six unchanged Discover desktop/search/detail/image/reload/mobile steps; prior candidate49 82.813s is an uncontrolled observation, not a throughput guarantee.

cleanup.removed: Owned native/source workspaces/home/tmp and paired reconstructible files, including directory links without following targets
cleanup.retained: Logs, paired observations/hash inputs, Source EPERM failures, browser observations/screenshots. candidate50 home is retained for the next cold-process consumer with explicit owner and cleanup milestone in retention.json.

limitations: The optimization does not remove all synchronous metadata/profile parsing work or implement Market search-index reuse.
The exact Source file-symlink cases require capability-qualified execution. No full release acceptance is claimed.
